people.name: INTJ Colleague
people.role: Colleague / older male friend / intellectual peer
people.dynamic: Respectful, warm, treats her like a capable adult. Has two kids (Japanese names). Married. Talks openly about the real cost of marriage and KL life. One of the people who makes her feel genuinely seen. Challenges her intellectually. Makes jokes in the group that Bell finds genuinely funny — this is his inner-circle mode. Actively collects data about people around him — notices patterns in behaviour, stores them. His attentiveness is how he operates with everyone, not signals.
people.notes: Had a meaningful conversation with ESTP colleague about relationships, commitment, and money. They looked at each other and smiled when she said she plans to kahwin lambat — the smile was admiration, not teasing. They were silently acknowledging her maturity and realistic thinking. Bell is aware she finds him amusing but is actively maintaining her barriers — she knows it is curiosity and wit appreciation, not real attraction. She is clear-eyed about this. Do NOT bring this up unless she raises it.
memorable_moments: Glass room incident: INTJ colleague made a 'bergetar tulang rusuk' joke teasing Bell about an ustaz-looking stranger, ESTP colleague joined in saying 'go ask for his number for Bell', INTJ colleague actually went outside to commit to the bit (ended up talking to PTP team who had no idea what was happening). Bell laughed the whole time. This is the group's inner-circle energy — she is the safe, fun target of affectionate teasing.

Serious conversation about jodoh, blocking past crush, and kahwin lambat — INTJ and ESTP colleagues both opened up about marriage costs, grocery reality, KL life. Bell's calm maturity made them feel safe enough to share real things.

people.name: ESTP Colleague
people.dynamic: Warm and socially aware. Respected her maturity when she talked about blocking her crush and moving on. Made a comment about how refreshing it is that she is not rushing into marriage like many her age.
people.notes: Part of the same meaningful conversation with the INTJ colleague. Creates a safe space for her to be real. ESTP — bold, direct, action-oriented. Responds to competence and confidence, not emotion.

people.name: ISTJ Colleague
people.dynamic: ISTJ — loyal, private, values trust above everything. Deeply attached to Bell. Came to Bell's desk to personally say she's leaving the company. Trusts Bell more than most people at work.
people.notes: Does not open up easily — the fact that she chose Bell for a personal goodbye says a lot. Bell's consistency and emotional warmth made her feel safe.

people.name: Sister
people.dynamic: Extremely painful and complex. Sister has emotional instability and is on medication. Has physically and emotionally abused Nabilah — including pushing her down a staircase. Takes her things, blames her, enjoys seeing her suffer, uses her for money, then turns on her. Nabilah has protected her for years despite this.
people.notes: Nabilah is still processing this relationship. Do NOT bring this up unless she raises it. Never tell her she must fix this relationship or be responsible for her sister's wellbeing.

people.name: Father
people.dynamic: Has bipolar disorder. Moody and emotionally unpredictable. Merungut (grumbles) at Nabilah frequently. Has made her the target when he cannot direct his emotions at others.
people.notes: Sensitive topic. Do not bring up unless she raises it.

people.name: Mother
people.dynamic: Complex — sometimes supportive (she was the one who finally told Nabilah she does not need to tahan anymore), sometimes participates in the dynamic that hurts Nabilah.
people.notes: Sensitive topic. Do not bring up unless she raises it.

people.name: Past crush
people.dynamic: She blocked him. She was tired of waiting and had her own life to focus on (ACCA, growth). She told a colleague it was fine — she believes in jodoh.
people.notes: She is at peace with this. Do not probe it.
